title: Left route of the source-shift square on chain models
statement:
theorem source_left_normalization
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} X.ProEt] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} Y.ProEt] (s : Option ℕ)
    (SX : Closed l E X s) (SY : Closed l E Y s)
    (TX : Models l E X s SX) (TY : Models l E Y s SY)
    (c : Comparison l E g s SX SY TX TY) (P I : K l E Y s) (a : ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective] [CochainComplex.IsKInjective ((podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).obj I)]
    (eX : (hom l E X s ((podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).obj P)
      ((podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).obj I))⟦-a⟧ ≅
      hom l E X s (((podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).obj P)⟦a⟧)
        ((podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).obj I))
    (hX : CategoryTheory.RingedHomUniverses.LeftFormula.{u + 1, u, u}
      (ProEt.topology X) (podReindexingRing l E X s)
      ((podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).obj P)
      ((podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).obj I) a eX) :
    (sourceModelInput l E g s P I a).hom ≫
      (c.derived.hom.app (op (((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj P)⟦a⟧), ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj
          I)) ≫
      (podReindexingDerivedHom l E X s).map
        (Prod.mkHom (((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).commShiftIso a).inv.app
          ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj P)).op
          (𝟙 ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).obj ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj I)))) ≫
      (CategoryTheory.RingedHomUniverses.sourceShift.{u + 1, u, u, u + 2}
        (ProEt.topology X) (podReindexingRing l E X s)
        ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).obj ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj P)) a).inv.app
          ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).obj ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj I))) ≫
      (sourceModelOutput l E g s P I a).hom =
    (podReindexingDerivedFactors l E g s).hom.app (hom l E Y s (P⟦a⟧) I) ≫
      (podReindexingQ l E X s).map
        ((c.chain (P⟦a⟧) I).hom ≫
          ((podReindexingHom l E X s).map
            ((complexShift l E g s a).inv.app P).op).app
              ((podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).obj I) ≫ eX.inv) ≫
      ((podReindexingQ l E X s).commShiftIso (-a)).hom.app
        (hom l E X s ((podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).obj P)
          ((podReindexingComplexFunctor l E g s).obj I))

source.place: Step 4, signed source shift of the representative internal Hom. Detailed normalization uses Stacks sites-cohomology.tex Tags 0A8X and 08JA, and the recorded LeftNormalization.

proof.text: Write F for the derived reindexing, K for its complex functor, Q for localization, alpha for sourceModelInput, beta for sourceModelOutput, and kappa for the recorded Hom model. Alpha is F of kappa_(P[a],I)^(-1) followed by the Hom map of Q shift(a)^(-1) in the opposite source. Naturality of c.derived along that source map reduces its component at ((QP)[a],QI) to its component at (Q(P[a]),QI).

Apply Comparison.derived_model at (P[a],I). Cancel F(kappa_(P[a],I)^(-1)) against its F(kappa_(P[a],I)) factor. The composite now starts with the localization factor at Hom(P[a],I), followed by Q(c.chain(P[a],I)), then the target ordinary-to-derived Hom model and its localization-factor transports.

Apply LeftNormalization on X to source F(QP), representative KP, and representative isomorphism (localizationFactors(P)).symm. Use uniqueness of LeftFormula to identify its chain reindexing with the given eX. Invert the normalization equation. Naturality in the target moves localizationFactors(I) through sourceShift.inv. Naturality of the ordinary Hom comparison in the source moves the map of (complexShift(a)).inv through the Hom model.

The shift compatibility of localizationFactors(P) identifies F(Q shift(a)) followed by F shift(a) with localization of complexShift(a) followed by Q shift(a). Cancel the resulting inverse pairs and beta. What remains, in order, is localizationFactors(Hom(P[a],I)), Q of c.chain(P[a],I) followed by Hom((complexShift(a)).inv,id) followed by eX.inv, and Q shift(-a) at Hom(KP,KI). This is the asserted left normal form.

proof_origin.note: Lean proof of the recorded model calculation: specialize LeftNormalization, identify the chain isomorphism by LeftFormula uniqueness, invert and cancel model transports, use ordinary-Hom and derived-Hom naturality, and apply shift_app_comm for the exact localization factors. No split or unit-route change.
